objections.about: The reply calls Seedance 'one of its included models,' which the help page never ties to any price, so a customer could read 'included' as free, while the section says the animation is paid and goes through kie.ai.

The customer calls the generate skill free, but the section says animation is a paid step that spends provider (kie.ai) credits the user must configure separately, and the reply never corrects that premise or says the kie.ai credits are what this run uses.
